newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil says China Lufeng oilfield on time.
newsitem.headline: Statoil says China Lufeng oilfield on time.

text.p: Drilling of five production wells on the Lufeng oilfield in the South China Sea was completed on schedule, operator Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday.
Statoil said well completion would take 70 days and installation of subsea equipment and production tubing was underway.
Lufeng oil will be produced by the Munin multipurpose vessel, which is due to arrive at the development in late October. Production is scheduled to begin in December.
Statoil is operator for the field in cooperation with Chinese state oil company Chinese National Offshore Oil Co (CNOOC).

Lufeng lies in an established oil province about 250 km (155 miles) off Hong Kong and contains about 35 million barrels of oil -- less than in Statoil's Yme field, the smallest independent development on the Norwegian continental shelf.
